test_client_lambda_call: test calling a lambda bound method on the courier client with positional arguments
test_client_class_method: test calling a class method bound to the courier server via the client proxy
test_server_rebind: test rebinding a server method and verifying the client sees the updated binding
test_async_future_call: test making an async future call on the courier client and retrieving its result
test_client_timeout: test the courier client timeout behavior with sync and async calls exceeding the deadline
